add-column: The nullable text column has no default, so adding it changes catalog metadata only and rewrites no decision rows; lock acquisition is bounded by 1s and the statement by 30s.
add-constraint: The CHECK is added NOT VALID, so PostgreSQL records it without scanning existing decision rows and enforces it only on new writes; validation runs later under SHARE UPDATE EXCLUSIVE, after the backfill derives every row. Lock acquisition is bounded by 1s and the statement by 30s.
create-trigger: Creating the row trigger updates catalog metadata only and scans no decision rows; lock acquisition is bounded by 1s and the statement by 30s.
replace-view: The two decision views re-expand their existing SELECT * definitions to include parsed_input_state while preserving the redaction and listing filters; replacement updates view metadata without scanning corpus rows, under 1s lock_timeout and 30s statement_timeout.
